title: Foundation checkpoint
subtitle: Read forms, phrases, and short clauses with care.
overview: You can now decode the alphabet, recognize core articles and cases, and locate basic finite verbs.
Do not rush ahead until you can read these small lines aloud, parse them, and explain why your translation works.

items.en: In the beginning was the Word.

items.grc: οἱ μαθηταὶ ἀκούουσιν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ.
items.en: The disciples hear the word of God.

items.grc: τὸ φῶς φαίνει ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ.
items.en: The light shines in the darkness.
